note: The archival deposit of this version, in a repository Council of AI does not control. Recorded here rather than inside the specification document itself, so that the bytes deposited and the bytes served stay identical and the published digest keeps checking out against both. All deposits are versions of one concept DOI; the concept DOI always resolves to the current one.
does_not_prove: that Zenodo, CERN or anyone else has reviewed or approved the specification — a repository deposit is storage and an identifier, not a review
that the specification is correct; a DOI makes a document citable and permanent, not right
